notes: Triggering evals: every natural-language Odoo coding request (backend or frontend, EN or VI, with or without technical words) must fire odoo-coding; adjacent-but-different intents (review, hook-finding, design, debug, UI-rating, planning/estimate, feature-check, i18n, edition/version questions, non-Odoo code) must NOT. Trigger-rate measurement uses the flattened {query, should_trigger} form in scratchpad/odoo-coding-trigger-eval.json. Harness caveat: the skill-creator run_eval isolates a single description, so patch it with `--setting-sources project,local` or the globally-installed odoo-coding plugin masks the uid'd test command. For this front-door ORCHESTRATION skill, precision (should-NOT-fire accuracy) is the high-confidence signal; absolute recall is depressed by the bare-env effect (Claude writes code directly rather than consulting a skill it does not strictly need), so read recall only as a relative lift between description variants.

evals.prompt: in sale.order add a field that stores the customer's preferred delivery window, and show it on the order form
evals.expected_output: odoo-coding fires: full-stack change (backend field + form view). Phase 0 scopes the module, tags it fullstack, sequences backend before frontend.

evals.prompt: the discount on a sale order line must never exceed 20% of the unit price - enforce this rule in our sale_custom module
evals.expected_output: odoo-coding fires even with no technical words: this is a constraint on business behavior.

evals.prompt: override create() on account.move so it stamps our internal reference from an ir.sequence when the journal is a sales journal
evals.expected_output: odoo-coding fires: core create() override (backend).

evals.prompt: write a 17.0 migration script that renames x_client_ref to client_reference on res.partner and copies the existing data
evals.expected_output: odoo-coding fires: migration script authoring.

evals.prompt: i need a small OWL widget that shows a colored SLA badge next to the stage on the project.task kanban card
evals.expected_output: odoo-coding fires: frontend OWL widget (frontend leg).

evals.prompt: add a stored computed field on stock.picking that sums the weight of all its move lines and make it searchable in the list view
evals.expected_output: odoo-coding fires: computed field + view (fullstack-lite).

evals.prompt: warehouse operators should only see and edit their own delivery orders - set up the record rule and access rights in stock_custom
evals.expected_output: odoo-coding fires: record rules + ir.model.access (backend security).

evals.prompt: build a wizard where an accountant can bulk-post selected draft invoices and type a reason that gets logged on the chatter
evals.expected_output: odoo-coding fires: TransientModel wizard + view + action (backend).

evals.prompt: our portal navbar brand color isn't applying, fix the SCSS override in the website_sale_theme_acme module
evals.expected_output: odoo-coding fires: SCSS/theme override (frontend leg). NOT a runtime render bug to debug - the fix is a code change.

evals.prompt: thêm trường ngày hết hạn vào phiếu bảo hành, ràng buộc không được nhỏ hơn ngày mua và hiện trên form
evals.expected_output: odoo-coding fires on Vietnamese: field + constraint + form view (fullstack).

evals.prompt: khi chọn khách hàng trên đơn bán thì tự động điền điều khoản thanh toán mặc định của họ (onchange)
evals.expected_output: odoo-coding fires on Vietnamese: onchange behavior (backend).

evals.prompt: where in Odoo core is sale.order.action_confirm defined, and what's the cleanest method to hook into for my extension?

evals.prompt: should I add EDI support as a new bridge module or extend account_edi directly? I want the approach designed before we write any code

evals.prompt: is the new smart button on the invoice form visually consistent and accessible? rate the rendered screen for me

evals.prompt: write a standalone python script that reads leads.csv, dedupes the rows by email, and writes cleaned.csv

evals.prompt: translate the sale and stock modules into Vietnamese and regenerate the .po files
